title: Telehealth Sick-Visit Copay
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — telehealth services rate sheet**

This rate sheet applies when primary care office visits are re-rated as preventive or coordinated care. A sick visit that a primary care visit log being read records as a telehealth visit re-rates at a telehealth sick-visit copay set by the practice type of the member's current assignment in the Primary Care Provider Assignment records.

## Rates

| Current practice type | Re-rated copay per telehealth sick visit |
|---|---|
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 1.00 USD |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 1.00 USD |
| Any other practice type | 2.50 USD |

**Clause.** A sick visit a log that is read records as a telehealth visit re-rates at the medical-home telehealth sick-visit copay of 1.00 USD when the current practice is a Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or Federally Qualified Health Center Home, and at the other-practice telehealth sick-visit copay of 2.50 USD when it is not; with no such telehealth sick visit, nothing is re-rated under this rule.

A medical-home practice, for this rate sheet, is a current assignment of practice type Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or Federally Qualified Health Center Home; every other practice type is not a medical home.

## Hypothetical cases

Inputs chosen for illustration only.

| Telehealth sick visits counted | Current practice | Re-rated copay |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 1.00 for each of the 2 visits |
| 2 | Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 1.00 for each of the 2 visits |
| 2 | Standard Primary Care Provider | 2.50 for each of the 2 visits |
| 0 | Any | Nothing re-rated under this rule |
